records.title: Toyota Hilux Revo 4x4

meta._sv3_v_description:
The Toyota Hilux Revo is the vehicle for groups whose trip involves gear as much as people: camping equipment, trekking kit, photography cases, or anything else that does not belong inside a passenger cabin.

The double cabin seats five in air-conditioned comfort while the open bed behind takes a load that no SUV of similar cost could carry. For a group heading to Sharan Forest with tents, or a photography team with cases, or anyone combining Shogran with a trek towards Makra Peak, this is the practical answer.

Mechanically it is a genuine four-wheel drive built for rough use rather than a road vehicle with badges. Diesel torque, high ground clearance and a chassis designed for load mean the Kiwai climb, the Siri Paye track and the rougher approach to Sharan Forest are all within its normal range rather than at its limit.

The automatic gearbox in our newer Revos makes the mountain sections easier than the manual versions, particularly on sustained hairpin descents.

The trade-off is that it seats five, not seven, and the ride is firmer than a Fortuner or Prado because the suspension is built to carry weight. For a family looking for comfort on a five-hour drive, the Fortuner is the better choice. For a group who need to bring things, the Revo is the only real answer in this price range.

Cargo in the open bed should be secured and covered, particularly in monsoon season. Our drivers carry straps and a cover as standard.

Every Revo goes out serviced with tyres checked for the terrain you have described to us, so tell us what you are actually planning. Rates are per day or fixed point-to-point, and multi-day trips are quoted as a package including the driver.

records.title: Siri Paye 4x4 Jeep

meta._sv3_v_description:
This is the vehicle that actually gets you to Siri Paye, and it is a different proposition from everything else in our fleet.

The track from Shogran up to the meadows is 8 to 10 kilometres of rock and dirt with severe gradients, gaining roughly 1,700 feet to around 9,500 feet. It takes 45 minutes to an hour each way. That timing tells you what the surface is like. No car, crossover or soft-roader makes it, and even capable rental SUVs are often better left parked in Shogran.

Our local jeeps are built and maintained specifically for this track, with low-range four-wheel drive, suspension set up for the surface and tyres chosen for it. More importantly they come with drivers who run this route daily through the season and know every section of it, including where to stop for the views most visitors drive past.

Pricing is per jeep, not per person. A group of six splits it comfortably; a couple does not. If you are travelling as two, ask us about sharing a jeep with another party, which is common and works well.

The single most useful thing we can tell you is to leave Shogran by 7 AM. Cloud builds over the meadow through the morning and regularly closes it in completely by eleven, particularly in July and August. Booking a jeep for ten o'clock is how people end up driving an hour to photograph fog.

Waiting time at the meadow is available and should be agreed upfront so there is no discussion at the top. Expect no mobile signal and no card payment up there.

The track is seasonal, running roughly May to October. It closes under snow in winter and no operator will take you up, whatever you are told. Ask us for current status before planning around it.

Shogran, Siri Paye & Sharan Tours – Corporate, Family, Honeymoon & Adventure Trips

Welcome to ShogranValley.com, your ultimate destination for exploring Shogran, Siri Paye, and Sharan. We offer a wide variety of tours to suit every traveler — whether you are planning a corporate retreat, a family vacation, a romantic honeymoon, a group outing, or an adventure-filled hiking trip. Our tours combine breathtaking scenery, comfort, and unforgettable experiences in the beautiful Kaghan Valley.

Explore the top visiting points of Kaghan Valley

Shogran Valley: Enjoy peaceful pine forests, mountain views, and a perfect environment for relaxation or corporate retreats. Siri Paye Meadows: Famous for lush green meadows, Paye Lake, and panoramic views, perfect for honeymooners, adventure seekers, and photographers. Sharan Forest: Dense forest, serene walking trails, and peaceful surroundings — ideal for hiking, team-building activities, or a quiet escape.

Tours We Offer

We cater to every type of traveler with diverse tour experiences, including: Corporate Tours: Team-building retreats, off-site meetings, workshops, and conferences in a scenic mountain setting. Family Tours: Safe and fun trips for families of all sizes, with activities suitable for adults and children. Honeymoon Tours: Romantic getaways to Shogran, Siri Paye, or Sharan for couples seeking privacy and stunning views. Group Tours: Excursions for friends, schools, universities, or clubs, tailored for larger groups. Adventure Tours: Off-road jeep rides, trekking, and nature exploration for thrill-seekers. Hiking Tours: Guided hikes through meadows, forests, and mountain trails for nature enthusiasts. And More: Flexible tours combining multiple destinations and activities to create the perfect itinerary.

Why Choose Our Tours?

Flexible & Customized: Tours for families, couples, groups, corporate teams, or solo travelers. Convenient Access: Shogran, Siri Paye, and Sharan are easily reachable from Islamabad, Lahore, and nearby cities. Breathtaking Natural Beauty: Pine forests, meadows, lakes, waterfalls, and mountain views in every tour. Professional Services: Comfortable accommodations, private jeeps, guided sightseeing, and attentive travel support. Adventure & Relaxation Combined: Perfect for both thrill-seekers and those looking to unwind amidst nature. Plan Your Next Trip Whether you are looking for a corporate retreat, a family getaway, a honeymoon adventure, or an exciting hiking tour, our Shogran, Siri Paye, and Sharan tours are designed to create memorable experiences for everyone.
